title: The Impersonal Critical Gaze with Se

sections.content:
You know passive *se* (verb agrees with a noun: *se organizan reuniones*) and impersonal *se* (no noun, always singular: *se trabaja mucho aquí*) from B1 Unit 6. In exhibition reviews, impersonal *se* creates a shared, objective critical gaze in two structures that frequently trip up advanced learners:

• **Intransitive and prepositional verbs**: always 3rd-person singular (*Desde el patio se accede a la galería principal*, *En esta exposición se reflexiona sobre la memoria*).
• **Human objects introduced by personal *a***: when *se* combines with a plural human direct object marked by *a*, the construction is impersonal and the verb **must stay singular** (*Se invita a los visitantes a detenerse*, *Se homenajea a las artesanas locales*, never `*se invitan a los visitantes*`).

sections.title: Impersonal se (always singular) vs passive se (agrees)
rows: En la galería se contemplan veinte retratos.
Twenty portraits are contemplated in the gallery. (passive se: plural noun, no 'a')
Se invita a los visitantes a recorrer la sala en silencio.
Visitors are invited to walk through the room in silence. (impersonal se: a + plural human -> singular verb)
Se homenajea a las artesanas de la cerámica tradicional.
Traditional ceramic artisans are honoured. (impersonal se: singular verb)
Desde el jardín se entra directamente en el pabellón.
From the garden one enters directly into the pavilion. (intransitive -> singular)

items.spanish: Al entrar en la galería se percibe una calma poco habitual en una gran exposición.
items.english: On entering the gallery one perceives a calm that is unusual in a large exhibition.

items.spanish: En la última sala se homenajea a las artesanas que trabajaron la cerámica junto a la artista.
items.english: In the final room the artisans who worked ceramics alongside the artist are honoured.

items.spanish: Se invita a los espectadores a contemplar los dibujos a carboncillo desde muy cerca.
items.english: Viewers are invited to contemplate the charcoal drawings from very close up.

items.spanish: En estos retratos se aprecia la influencia de los talleres populares.
items.english: In these portraits the influence of popular workshops is discerned.

sections.content: The number-one C1 agreement trap with *se*: whenever personal *a* introduces a plural human object (*a los visitantes*, *a las artesanas*), there is no grammatical subject, so the verb stays singular (*se invita a los visitantes*, *se homenajea a las artesanas*). Only a bare plural noun without *a* triggers a plural verb (*se contemplan los retratos*).
